title: date -J record
description: One time printed by `date -J` (one per line of --file). One record per line (NDJSON); version 1 of the Dogfish record format (doc/ndjson.md). Fields may be added in later releases.

time.description: The time shown: RFC 3339, UTC, with nanoseconds.

time_ns.description: The time shown: nanoseconds since the epoch.

utc_offset.description: The local time zone's offset from UTC at that time, in seconds east.

zone.description: The local time zone's abbreviation at that time (`%Z`).

zone_bytes.description: The bytes of `zone`, base64, present only when they are not UTF-8 (`zone` then holds the lossy form).

formatted.description: The time as date would print it (FORMAT, or the default format).
